title: flagged content hides itself, and the poster is told why

criteria.text: Anything a member can post is reportable (photos, Pages, announcements, posts); a report triggers agent classification
criteria.note: Six subject kinds go through `report.create`: Page photo, Page picture, post, post photo, the Page's own words (`page_words`, #820, closed #625) and a featured product or service (`page_item`, #920); the checks on `reports`, `member_notices` and `legal_holds` carry all six (migration 20261019013909); `run-assessment.ts` joins each kind's text and photo for the shadow read [V] Checked: `[guards F078.1]` in `f078-reportable-everything.test.ts:163` (#1036, closed #1005): every registered action is classified as a poster or as posting nothing, every poster's kind is accepted and stored and queued for the AI read, and no other kind is accepted; seen failing against eight mutants; F117 (#1081) and F118 (#1093) added their new actions to its classification [V] Reviewed: #820 `review-skipped`; #499, #513 clean; #920 carries `Reviewed by:` [V] Shipped: deploy-health green on #820 (e82442f), #920 (0aa3c68) and #1036 (3e5020d) [V] Smoked: `page` and `page-business` green 2026-10-27 (dccf21c); the menu entries render, no report is sent [A]

criteria.text: A first report leaves the post up and sends a courtesy notice; a second report from a different member hides it and sends it to a person
criteria.note: `create.ts`: `shouldHide` needs `priorByOthers > 0`; the first report writes a courtesy notice (#706) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.2]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:241`, seen failing against four mutants (#901, closed #834) [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Shipped: green on #494, #499, #506, #706 [V] Smoked: the `report-sent` route exists in `evals/screens/routes.ts` but `smoke-live` has no live address for it (`LIVE_PATHS` in `evals/smoke/live.spec.ts`), so no run sends a report [V]

criteria.text: Poster told at once, in-app (never email), with the category, the reporter's reason and a plain explanation
criteria.note: `member_notices` row written in the hide transaction; `YouNotices` on `/you`; child content sends none by ruling (F078 criterion 8) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.3]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:72`; the never-email guard in `f078-guards.test.ts:21` is partial on purpose (the in-app write is the handler's check) [V] Reviewed: #494, #706 `review-skipped` [V] Shipped: green [V] Smoked: `you` green 2026-10-27 (dccf21c); the notices list renders, none is seeded [A]

criteria.text: The poster can submit one explanation; an unanswered takedown stays hidden and closes itself
criteria.note: `report.answer` one per hide, a single "This is a mistake" button (#706); an unanswered hide closes after 14 days (#773) [V] Checked: `f078-criteria.test.ts:300` (the #834 check, seen failing against three mutants in #901) now carries `[guards F078.4 partial: ...]` since #1035 (closed #1020: the scenario has no 4a, so the marker cites 4); its only exclusion is the retired 4b clause, so it claims all of 4a [V] Reviewed: #706, #773 `review-skipped` [V] Shipped: #1035 (c3845a8) green [V] Smoked: the answer button lives on `/you` behind a seeded notice; no run has one [V]

criteria.text: Submitting an explanation is the only thing that creates work for a person
criteria.note: RETIRED. Overtaken by the 2026-10-11 courtesy-notice ruling in F078 `## Rulings` (and criterion 6): a second report now sends the item to a person. The partial markers at `f078-criteria.test.ts:169` and `:300` say so. The scenario still carries the old clause in criterion 4; `sync-roadmap` amends it [V].

criteria.note: `alertOperator` after commit: SMS when Twilio values exist, email through Resend today (#751); the mobile queue is `/admin/reports` [V]. Nobody is texted yet: no Twilio number (#707 open, unchanged this week) [V]. The alert text says "hid a Page photo" for a picture, post photo, words or item too (#901's note) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.5]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:95` [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped`; #751 no `Reviewed by:` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green as operator 2026-10-26 (dc65fac) [V]

criteria.note: A report is always stored and queued; hiding is separate (`create.ts`) [V] Checked: `[guards F078.6]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:120` [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-26 (dc65fac) [V]

(no numbers, per the 2026-10-11 copy ruling; untouched by #1087) [V]; strikes counted at report time in `create.ts` [V] Checked: `[guards F078.10]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:335` claims the line before Send and the strikes together, seen failing against three mutants (#901); the strikes-only marker in `create.test.ts:793` is partial [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: no run opens the sheet [V]
